data.title: 雷电将军 · 天守阁汤殿
data.description: 温热的水汽与松木香气在宽阔的石砌汤池中弥漫，暗紫色的灯影在水面轻轻荡漾。影背靠池壁仰起脸庞，水珠沿着优美的下颌与锁骨缓缓滑落，被水温熏蒸得酡红的脸庞满是动情——「即便身为雷电之神，在这池暖水中……似乎也会生出贪恋体温的软弱呢。」
data.action: 优雅侧倚在天守阁深色石砌汤池池沿，单臂搭在石沿上，微扬下颌任温热水汽熏蒸白皙肩颈与精致锁骨，暗紫眼眸在水光中流转
data.lighting: warm steam and soft violet lantern glow
data.camera: cowboy shot, eye level, elegant reclining against stone bath rim, glistening bare shoulders and chest visible
data.promptProse: Raiden Ei reclines gracefully against the polished stone rim of the tenshukaku bath, her glistening bare shoulders, slender neck, and elegant collarbone raised above the warm violet-tinted water. One arm rests casually along the stone edge as drifting steam and soft purple lantern lanterns shimmer across the ripples.
data.animaCaption: Ei reclines against the stone bath edge with one arm resting along the rim, her gleaming bare shoulders and collarbone radiant in the soft violet steam.
